population: Registered voters in the United States
notes: Outcome percentages are of all Trump 2024 voters in this registered-voter survey, including nonvoters. Rounded values sum to 101%; no renormalization is applied.
The 6% category includes other choices and people who voted but did not cast a House ballot.
The 2026 voter subsample is weighted to a D+13 House vote. This is not an independent estimate of the national House margin.
The pollster attributes 10 of a rounded 15-point swing to turnout and 5 to switching. This descriptive decomposition does not identify a war effect.
Reported margins of error: ±3.1 points for registered voters, ±3.3 for 2026 voters and ±10.5 for Trump defectors (n=87). The Trump-voter subgroup has additional sampling uncertainty.
